items.html: Thus, in this throat, on its two sides, there are two names of Ehyeh, similar to the one name of Yud-Hey-Vav in Hochma, which is 42. Now, the two drops of female waters mentioned are these two names of Ehyeh, both of which equal 42 in gematria. Yet each of them must also allude to 42, as mentioned, so that two [times] 42 rise and one 42 descends. This will be explained further below.
